explication: This repository provides reusable Terraform modules for provisioning Google Cloud SQL, with MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL as its documented entry points. The principal workflow is a Terraform user configuring one of those modules and applying it to create a Cloud SQL instance. The tree also identifies backup, restore, private-service-access, and safer-MySQL modules; their internal connections are not shown in the supplied excerpts, so they are represented without guessed links. The sampled migration helper is a separate state-migration utility.
